description: This PHP class 'Publisher' is part of the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Confluence' namespace and handles publishing content to Confluence. It manages page creation, updates, diff comparisons, and recursive publishing of page hierarchies, utilizing external client and configuration dependencies.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: A class that manages publishing pages and hierarchies to Confluence, including creating, updating, diff comparison, and handling recursive publishing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Publisher with configuration, API client, output interface, and width.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an action with a title and a closure, managing output and possibly additional logic.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Performs a diff comparison of local and remote page structures and outputs differences.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Coordinates the publishing process, including fetching existing pages, creating placeholders, and updating pages.

methods.name: rootNotFound
methods.description: Handles error when root page is not found and suggests config options.

methods.name: configureSpace
methods.description: Sets the space key in the client and configuration based on a page.

methods.name: getRootPage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the root page of the hierarchy.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page under a parent.

methods.name: recursiveWithCallback
methods.description: Recursively processes child pages with a callback function.

methods.name: createRecursive
methods.description: Creates pages recursively based on the hierarchy.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates a page if necessary, including attachments.
